spans.s: ज्येष्ठ (I) a. (f. ष्ठा; the super. of प्रशस्य and वृद्ध) 1. Most excellent, best; 2. preeminent, first, chief; 3. eldest, most senior.
ज्येष्ठ (II) m. 1. Elder brother, R.xii.19, 35; 2. name of a lunar month, (the same as ज्यैष्ठ q.v.).
ज्येष्ठ (I) a. (f. ष्ठा; the super. of प्रशस्य and वृद्ध) 1. Most excellent, best; 2. preeminent, first, chief; 3. eldest, most senior.
ज्येष्ठा f. 1. An elder sister; 2. name of the eighteenth lunar mansion consisting of three stars; 3. the middle finger; 4. a house-lizard; 5. an epithet of the Ganges.
ज्येष्ठ-अंश m. 1. the elder brother’s share, the right of the elder brother to a greater share of patrimony; 2. the best share.
ज्येष्ठ-अंबु n. water in which grain has been washed.
ज्येष्ठ-आश्रम m. 1. the most excellent order in the religious life of a Brāhmaṇa, viz., that of a householder; 2. a householder.
ज्येष्ठ-तात m. a father’s elder brother.
ज्येष्ठ-वृत्ति f. the duties of seniority.
ज्येष्ठ-श्वश्रू f. a wife’s elder sister.
